title: Add IP-based location detection to booking form

requirements.text: In BookingPage.tsx and/or BookingFormSection.tsx, implement IP-based location detection using ipapi.co/json/ (no API key required). On component mount, use a useEffect + fetch call to ipapi.co/json/. Display a status message ('📍 Detecting location...', '✅ Location detected!', or '❌ Could not detect location. Please enter manually.' / '❌ Location service unavailable. Please enter manually.' on error). Auto-fill the address field with city, region, country_name from the API response if the field is empty. Store latitude and longitude values in hidden form fields (name='latitude', id='latitude' and name='longitude', id='longitude') that are submitted along with the booking form. Use React state and refs instead of direct DOM manipulation. Do not change any existing design, layout, animations, SEO content, or other functionality.

quotes: Add IP-based location detection using ip-api.com (no API key required).
Auto-fill address if address field exists
Build aur jo maine code diya hai agar usme kuch galat ho to sahi kar ke daal dena

acceptanceCriteria: On page load, a status message '📍 Detecting location...' appears near the booking form.
A successful ipapi.co/json/ response auto-fills the address field with 'city, region, country_name' if the field was empty.
Latitude and longitude from the API response are stored in hidden form inputs and submitted with the form.
On API success, status message updates to '✅ Location detected!'.
On API failure or network error, status message updates to an appropriate error message prompting manual entry.
Implementation uses React useEffect and fetch (no plain <script> tags or direct document.getElementById DOM manipulation).
No changes to existing layout, animations, SEO content, or other form functionality.

constraints: Use ipapi.co/json/ as the location API endpoint — no API key required.
Do not use plain HTML <script> tags or direct DOM manipulation; use React hooks (useEffect, useState, useRef).
Do not change any existing design, layout, animations, SEO content, or form functionality.
Hidden latitude/longitude fields must be included in the form submission payload.
Address field should only be auto-filled if it is currently empty.
nonGoals: GPS/browser geolocation API — only IP-based detection via ipapi.co.
Storing location data in the backend.
Any changes to SEO meta tags, headings, or existing content.
Any changes to authentication, booking logic, or success overlay behavior.
